value.built_to: buffer data between a producer and consumer running at different rates, asserting 'full' to stall the producer and 'empty' to stall the consumer -- flow control in hardware
value.pressure: a producer and consumer with mismatched, bursty rates; without backpressure a fast producer overruns and data is lost
value.success_means: no overflow or underflow, in-order delivery, correct flags across the rate mismatch

value.pressure: rate mismatch and burstiness between producer and consumer; bounded buffer depth
value.failure_condition: overflow (fast producer, ignored 'full') drops data; underflow (consumer reads 'empty') reads garbage -- silent corruption downstream

ANCESTRY.value: A FIFO with full/empty flags and (in the async case) gray-coded pointers is the standard backpressure/flow-control element between two clock or rate domains -- it holds state and asserts 'full' to stall a fast producer

cut.note: a first-in-first-out buffer between two clock domains: write and read pointers one bit wider than the address so that full and empty are distinguished by the extra bit when the address parts are equal; each pointer is sampled into the other clock domain through one register stage; the flags are computed in the domain that uses them from the local pointer and the sampled foreign pointer, with a one-entry look-ahead so a flag is correct on the very cycle it matters; threshold flags (full_n, empty_n) come from a registered pointer difference; the header states the two-cycle status latency and that a binary pointer crossing is only safe with the gray-coded variant, which is a separate file

provenance.grade_basis: Techne FOSSIL_PACKET.json PROVENANCE_GRADE where issued, else the record's handoff string mapped (populated per R34; Harmonia may re-grade)

organs.human_name: reg [aw:0] wp, rp (68-70); wp_pl1 / rp_pl1; empty <= (wp_s == rp) | (re & (wp_s == rp_pl1)) (109); full <= (wp[aw-1:0] == rp_s[aw-1:0]) & (wp[aw] != rp_s[aw]) | ... (111)
organs.mechanism: the write and read pointers count modulo twice the depth; the low bits address the memory and the top bit records the wrap parity; the FIFO is empty when the pointers are equal in full and full when the address bits are equal but the wrap bits differ; each flag also looks one operation ahead (the pointer plus one under a read or write enable) so that it asserts on the cycle the last entry is consumed or the last slot filled, avoiding a cycle of illegal access
assumptions: one extra bit is cheaper than a separate count register or a 'last operation' flag; the look-ahead term costs one adder per flag
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: the standard flag discipline of every hardware FIFO
organs.failure_landscape: by reading: the header warns that writing when full or reading when empty puts the FIFO in an undefined state; the design detects it after the fact (the overrun/underrun bits at 128-133) rather than preventing it
organs.human_prior: Cummings & Alfke 2002 (simulation and synthesis techniques for asynchronous FIFO design)

organs.human_name: always @(posedge rd_clk) wp_s <= wp; always @(posedge wr_clk) rp_s <= rp (106-107); empty in rd_clk from wp_s and rp; full in wr_clk from wp and rp_s; the header: 'there is a 2 cycle' latency; DC_FIFO_ASYNC_RESET
organs.mechanism: the write pointer is registered on the read clock and the read pointer on the write clock; each domain computes its own flag from its own pointer (exact) and the sampled other pointer (stale by up to two cycles); staleness is safe in one direction only: a stale foreign pointer can make empty or full assert late-to-clear but never assert false-negative in the dangerous direction, so the FIFO is conservative rather than wrong; the header notes a binary multi-bit pointer can be sampled inconsistently and points to the gray-coded file for that case
assumptions: metastability on a multi-bit binary bus is the user's risk here (the gray variant exists for it); the conservative direction of staleness is what makes a stale flag acceptable
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: two clock domains decoupled with two registers and no handshake
organs.failure_landscape: by reading: a single register stage is not a two-flop synchroniser; a binary pointer sampled mid-transition can read an intermediate value (the reason the gray file exists)
organs.human_prior: Cummings' async FIFO papers; the gray-code pointer is the standard remedy
organs.source_boundary: the two sampling registers and the flag domains

organs.human_name: assign diff = wp - rp (113); diff_r1 / diff_r2 registered per domain; empty_n <= (diff_r1 < n) | ((diff_r1 == n) & (re | re_r)) (119); full_n <= (diff_r2 > max_size - n) | ((diff_r2 == max_size - n) & (we | we_r)) (125); level (two bits of occupancy quarter)
organs.mechanism: the occupancy is the pointer difference (correct modulo the wrap thanks to the wide pointers); it is registered in each domain and compared with a threshold n to produce 'at least n entries' and 'room for n more', with the same one-operation look-ahead on the enable (and its registered copy) so the flag tracks the boundary exactly; a two-bit level output reports the occupancy quarter
assumptions: consumers want to batch transfers (start when n are available) rather than react to every entry
organs.fitness_value_in_ancestor: burst-friendly flow control from the same pointers
organs.failure_landscape: by reading: the difference uses a foreign pointer that is itself stale, so thresholds inherit the latency

rejected_cuts.candidate: generic_fifo_dc_gray.v (the gray-coded pointer crossing), the single-clock variants (sc_a, sc_b), generic_fifo_lfsr.v and lfsr.v (an LFSR as the address counter to save an incrementer), the memory macro instance, the testbench
rejected_cuts.note: the gray variant is the safe form of organ 2 and should be read next; the LFSR addressing is a small mechanism of its own

rejected_cuts.evidence: pointer encoding, domain crossing and threshold logic are separable and the file set varies them independently

pressures.condition: a producer and a consumer run on independent clocks; a bounded buffer sits between them; the score is zero lost or duplicated words under every rate ratio, and throughput; status signals crossing domains are delayed and may be sampled mid-transition
pressures.resource_or_constraint: one memory; a few registers per domain
pressures.failure_condition: a write when full or a read when empty (corruption), or a false full/empty that halves throughput
pressures.world_punishes: flags computed from a foreign pointer without the wrap bit; binary pointers sampled across domains at speed
pressures.world_rewards: wide pointers, domain-local flags with conservative staleness, gray-coded crossing
pressures.observable_consequence: lost/duplicated words and throughput over rate ratios and clock phases in simulation, for the binary-pointer file vs the gray-pointer file, with metastability injected at the crossing
pressures.cheat_control: an organism with a global clock must show zero errors at full throughput; the binary-pointer FIFO with injected mid-transition samples must corrupt; the gray-pointer FIFO under the same injection must not: the world must show all three
